# tencentcloud-sdk-cdwdoris

**Tag**: devops

## 简介

Tencent Cloud Ruby SDK is the official software development kit, which allows Ruby developers to write software that makes use of Tencent Cloud service CDWDORIS.

- 主页: https://github.com/TencentCloud/tencentcloud-sdk-ruby
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/TencentCloud/tencentcloud-sdk-ruby/tencentcloud-sdk-cdwdoris
- 更新日志: https://github.com/TencentCloud/tencentcloud-sdk-ruby/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/tencentcloud-sdk-cdwdoris
